note: RFC 4271 Section 6.3 requires syntactic validation of AS_PATH; RFC 7606 Section 7.2 specifies treat-as-withdraw for unknown segment type, zero segment length, segment overrun, and single-octet underrun. TestSessionRFC4271RevisedAttributeErrors tests all four malformed AS_PATH forms with valid ORIGIN/NEXT_HOP/NLRI on a net.Pipe Session, asserting exact synthesized withdrawal bodies and session survival between valid AS_SEQUENCE controls that deliver the announced NLRI.
